result.summary: Three exact-state static-current-KL lineages continued from approximately 1M to at least 2.097M physical environment hands, adding 3,143,992 new hands. A 98,304-hand untouched four-anchor both-seat evaluation and 60,000-state Standard10 drift audit completed with all integrity and deck-disjoint checks passing.
result.conclusion: The preregistered 2M geometric gate passed: Seed2 and Seed3 slopes were positive (+1.663 and +0.134 bb/100), the median slope was positive, only Seed1 showed broad reversal, and Standard10 drift remained small. Combined slope was still -1.137 bb/100 with CI [-4.604,+2.329] and no seed met the stricter breadth-positive criterion, so this supports one further geometric observation rather than a claim of established strength.
result.next_step: Stage exact-state 2M-to-4M continuations for all three lineages with preserved optimizer/replay/league state and disjoint deal windows; preregister the same fresh multi-anchor both-seat and Standard10-drift gates, while treating replicated reversal or worsening breadth as the stop condition.
